strings.about.08e56bf1: Fishing after dark can be dangerous. Storms, lightning, heat, cold, slick ramps, and low visibility are real risks. Turn back when weather turns. Use lights, tell someone your plan, and wear a life jacket when appropriate. Hoover, Alum Creek, O’Shaughnessy, Griggs and Clear Fork are drinking-water reservoirs. At every lake, pack out trash and follow posted rules.
